/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 - <<'PY'
import csv
import io
from solution import load_people
h = 'name,email,age,active\\n'
invalid = ['', '\\n', 'name,email,age,age\\n', 'name,email,age,active,extra\\n',
           h+'Sam,s@x,30,true,extra', h+'Sam,s@x,30',
           h+',s@x,30,true', h+'Sam,,30,true', h+'Sam,a@@b,30,true',
           h+'Sam,@b,30,true', h+'Sam,a@,30,true', h+'Sam,a @b,30,true',
           h+'Sam,a@b,131,true', h+'Sam,a@b,+30,true', h+'Sam,a@b,-1,true',
           h+'Sam,a@b,3.0,true', h+'Sam,a@b,٣٠,true', h+'Sam,a@b,30,yes',
           h+'\"Sam,a@b,30,true', h+'Sa\"m,a@b,30,true',
           h+'\"Sam\"x,a@b,30,true', h+'Sam,a@b,30,true\\nBad,b@x,999,false',
           '\\ufeff\\ufeff'+h, h+'Sam,a@b,'+'9'*5000+',true']
for text in invalid:
    try:
        load_people(text)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(repr(text))
valid = [
    (h, []),
    (h+'\\n , , , \\n,,,,\\n', []),
    ('\\ufeff active , age , email , name \\r\\n FALSE , 130 , A@B , Sam \\r\\n',
     [{'name':'Sam','email':'a@b','age':130,'active':False}]),
    (h+'\"Sam, \\\"\\\"S\\\"\\\"\\nSavage\",s@x,000,TrUe\\n',
     [{'name':'Sam, \"S\"\\nSavage','email':'s@x','age':0,'active':True}]),
    (h+'Sam,s@x,'+'0'*5000+',0',
     [{'name':'Sam','email':'s@x','age':0,'active':False}]),
]
for text, expected in valid:
    assert load_people(text) == expected
for active, expected in [('true', True), ('1',True), ('false',False), ('0',False), ('',False)]:
    assert load_people(h+f'Sam,s@x,,{active}')[0]['active'] is expected
# Check that valid CSV written by the standard library survives quoting checks.
for name in ['Sam', 'A,B', 'A\"B', 'A\\rB', 'A\\nB', 'A\\r\\nB']:
    stream = io.StringIO(newline='')
    writer = csv.writer(stream)
    writer.writerow(['name','email','age','active'])
    writer.writerow([name,'a@b','0','true'])
    assert load_people(stream.getvalue())[0]['name'] == name
print('40 targeted checks passed (24 invalid, 16 valid).')
PY
 git diff --check
 git diff --stat"
